import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='#3498db')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
age_dist = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique(), 
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else (0 if '0' in x else 100))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order[:15], fill_value=0)
axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_district = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(district_counts)))
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors_district, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(district_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Dog Distribution Across Zurich Districts', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Owner and Dog Gender Distribution
owner_gender = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
dog_gender = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()

x_pos = [0, 1, 3, 4]
values = [owner_gender.get('männlich', 0), owner_gender.get('weiblich', 0),
          dog_gender.get('männlich', 0), dog_gender.get('weiblich', 0)]
colors_gender = ['#3498db', '#e91e63', '#3498db', '#e91e63']
labels = ['Owner\nMale', 'Owner\nFemale', 'Dog\nMale', 'Dog\nFemale']

axes[1, 1].bar(x_pos, values, color=colors_gender, alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Gender Distribution: Owners vs Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add text annotations for percentages
for i, (pos, val) in enumerate(zip(x_pos, values)):
    axes[1, 1].text(pos, val + max(values)*0.02, f'{val:,}', 
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
